title: Methanol Freeze Protected Heat Transfer Liquids
description: Freezing and flash points for methanol or methyl based heat-transfer fluids or brines. Determine freezing and flash points based on methanol concentration.

components.content:
## Methanol Freeze Protected Heat Transfer Liquids

This tool helps you determine the freezing and flash points of methanol-based heat transfer fluids based on methanol concentration.

### Warning
- HIGH flammability if pure
- HIGH toxicity

### Physical Properties of Methanol
- Molecular Weight: 32.04
- Boiling Point: 64.7°C
- Melting Point: -97.8°C
- Flash Point: 12°C (54°F) closed cup
- Auto ignition Temperature: 878°F
- Vapor Pressure: 92 mm Hg at 20°C
- Density/Specific Gravity: 0.7915 at 20/4°C (water = 1)
- Vapor Density: 1.11 (air = 1)
